men.summary: A 2-1 start, built on home wins over Kansas City (76-61) and Le Moyne (83-55), took a hit with the 89-82 loss at Kansas State on Nov 10, which also conflicts with the listed "2W" streak since that loss is the most recent game. With a NET of 83, an RPI of 204, no Quadrant 1 games yet and Big East play still ahead (0-0), the postseason outlook is wide open, and an at-large bid will depend on piling up quality conference wins.

women.summary: A 2-0 start built entirely on the road, with a 73-71 win at South Dakota State and a 66-60 win at North Dakota State, includes a 1-0 Quadrant 1 record and a 22 RPI, though the NET ranking sits at just 91. With Big East play still 0-0 and no home or neutral games played, the postseason outlook is wide open, and Creighton will need to lift that NET number through conference play to build an at-large case.
